What are lab-grown diamonds?
settings.answer: Lab-grown diamonds (LGDs), also known as man-made, cultured, or synthetic diamonds, are produced in a lab using advanced processes that replicate the natural geological process. They have the same physical, chemical, and optical properties as their natural counterparts. Learn more about lab-grown diamonds here.

settings.title: How are lab-grown diamonds made?
settings.answer: Lab-grown diamonds are created through chemical vapor deposition (CVD) or high-pressure high-temperature (HPHT) methods. Learn more about the process here.

settings.title: What are the 4Cs of diamonds?
settings.answer: Cut, clarity, color, and carat weight are most typically graded using this standard 4Cs method, considered the global standard for assessing diamond quality. Learn more about 4Cs here.

settings.title: What are the differences between HPHT and CVD diamonds?
settings.answer: The key difference between an HPHT diamond and a CVD diamond is in how they grow. The growth processes of HPHT and CVD diamonds result in distinct crystal structures, which could potentially be identified by a diamond expert under magnification and close inspection. Learn more about their differences here.

settings.title: Do you offer grading reports from independent laboratories?
settings.answer: We offer items featuring lab-grown diamonds and gemstones that come with grading reports from independent laboratories. Please contact our customer service team via email or online chat if you have any additional inquiries.

settings.title: How do I care for my diamond jewelry?
settings.answer: Dissolve one tablespoon of mild dish soap into a glass of warm water and let your jewelry go for a little swim. Scrub gently with a soft cloth or an old soft-bristle toothbrush before rinsing with clean water. For more in-depth cleaning tips, visit here.
